content: Hello, I am going into my 4th year of Maths at Imperial. I'm spending some time on enhancing my formalisation of the Schwarz-Pick lemma that I did in a course so that it's pr-ready ( https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Schwarz_lemma#Schwarz%E2%80%93Pick_theorem ) and then working on further results in the context of geometric complex analysis. I wish to start by adding more to the complex unit disc part in Mathlib and then building to the results.
